body:
Finite observers need different transport laws for truth, distinct proof receipts, probability and limiting reports. This draft extends VOYAGER with independently investigated and reviewed exact classifications, hostile source controls, and a navigable mathematical atlas. It preserves the original/current/history distinction and leaves EOS's Lean 4.19 sibling unmerged.

Formal changes include standalone kernel-checked predicate base change, actual pullback coverage and original-target fiber descent, plus a pinned Lean 4.14/Mathlib inverse-family topology proof: native closure homeomorphism, source realization iff closed image, compact source actualization, compact Hausdorff totally disconnected completion, continuous bonding maps and action transport. Local kernel receipts contain only standard axioms. A new selective-cache CI gate is included; the original cold remote run 38365807103 passed and its exact artifacts are preserved. Full repository CI 38365807118 also passed on Python 3.10 and 3.13.

The rolling swarm currently has 19 completed first-generation investigations and three completed synthesis dossiers, with acceptance and independent review state recorded separately in `research/2026-10-13/SWARM_ATLAS/registry.json`. The requested 48+12 operation is still underway. Surviving paper results cover predicate versus witness base change, restricted Yoneda adequacy, integral gluing obstructions, nonregular-cover descent, source-tagged Kan migration, lawful minimal repair, effective witness extraction limits, exact stochastic transport, Bayesian rank-one gluing, affine histories, bounded logistic factors and supported-receipt completion. Established results are labelled classical; academic originality and physical authentication are unclaimed.

Validation: all 1602 repository tests pass locally, provenance 72 passes, observer/ordinal probes pass, accepted targeted probes replay, and the native pinned topology gate passes under a guarded single-compiler process. Failed attempts and their repaired statements remain in receipts. No default, archival provenance, main, licensing, release or RH claim changes.

Base: `research/voyager-observational-profinite-completion-2026-10-13` (`5eb09e7cba36ec01b8f9d6834b78b5766fd93935`). Review the supplementary claim ledger, independent reviews, atlas and resumable checkpoint alongside each scoped semantic commit.

The expanded A01+B09 kernel gate passed locally; remote checks on the newest semantic checkpoint are running. Supported receipt closure, holonomy/orbit filtering (including independent Reynolds criterion), and adaptive modular gluing/typed repair are recorded as reviewed paper syntheses with exact hostile controls.
